name: The Guardians Ver.1
summary: The game “Guardians” is specifically designed for teenagers together having fun. The gaming scene is a fortress and you have to use the axes and magic to beat monsters with your VR controller. As a warrior guarding the fortress, the player must not retreat even a step when facing the attack of the monster army, and drive away all the monsters. In addition to throwing, you can also experience VR's close-range slashing when facing the endless attacks of monsters. Be more immersed in the feeling of charging in
